scenarios.name: drop_latest_records
scenarios.description: Drop the newest 20% of records to simulate a missed incremental load.

scenarios.name: blank_summary
scenarios.description: Blank summaries so retrieval and answer extraction lose abstract context.

scenarios.name: inject_noise
scenarios.description: Append garbage tokens to summaries to drift embeddings.

scenarios.name: truncate_title
scenarios.description: Truncate titles to fewer than 8 characters, breaking exact title lookup.

scenarios.name: stale_date
scenarios.description: Move published dates into the distant past to violate the freshness SLA.

scenarios.name: duplicate_rows
scenarios.description: Duplicate rows so paper_id uniqueness checks fail.
